description: Zero-provider-row metadata and aggregate reconciliation for the California CDSS Community Care Licensing ArcGIS migration.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects; fixed public item, service, layer and aggregate query URLs only.
checkpoint: Retain only validated metadata and aggregate responses after all eight fixed requests conserve.
idempotency: Each observation is immutable; repeated runs create distinct UUID receipts.
cancellation: Cooperative request cancellation and owned-staging cleanup.
retention_profile: Metadata and aggregate counts only; no provider rows, names, addresses, coordinates or phone values.
